title: Notice Ground Truth Annotation Schema
description: Standard ground-truth annotation format for Notice to Action evaluation harness.

notice_id.description: Unique identifier for the annotated notice document.

source_pdf.description: Path to the source PDF file relative to project root or fixture directory.

expected_category.description: Ground-truth notice category (e.g. tax_or_payment, bank, utility, scholarship_or_college, government_scheme, other_out_of_scope).

explicit_deadlines.description: List of all explicit or relative deadlines stated in the notice. Empty if none.

date.description: Normalized ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if relative/unparseable.

original_wording.description: Exact wording of the deadline as written in the notice.

description.description: Short plain-language description of what is due.

is_ambiguous.description: True if the deadline is relative, missing an anchor, or internally conflicting.

ambiguity_reason.description: Explanation of why the deadline is ambiguous.

required_documents.description: List of documents explicitly demanded or suggested in the notice.

action_steps.description: Sequential compliance instructions extracted directly from the notice.

submission_channel.description: Designated submission location, physical address, portal URL, or email; null if not stated.

penalties.description: Penalties, late fees, interest, or consequences mentioned in the notice.

ambiguous_or_missing_notes.description: Human notes on ambiguous, unclear, or intentionally absent fields for evaluating model uncertainty handling.

critical_evidence_passages.description: Ground-truth evidence citations verifying that every critical claim has a verbatim supporting quote in the PDF.

field.description: Identifier for the critical field (e.g. deadline, document, action_step, submission_channel, title, issuer, penalty).

page.description: 1-indexed page number in the source PDF where the quote appears.

quote.description: Verbatim quote extracted directly from that page of the PDF.
